analysis: The code calls pathToUse.substring(1) inside an if block that checks if pathToUse starts with '/'. The substring method throws IndexOutOfBoundsException if beginIndex is negative or larger than the length of the string. Since beginIndex is 1, and the condition ensures pathToUse starts with '/', the length of pathToUse is at least 1. Therefore beginIndex (1) is not negative and not larger than the length. Hence the exception condition is avoided. No other exceptions are declared for this method.
remark: No exceptions are triggered because the condition pathToUse.startsWith('/') guarantees that the string length is at least 1, so beginIndex 1 is valid.
